'use strict';

function parseCsvLine(line) {
  const fields = [];
  let value = '';
  let quoted = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i += 1) {
    const char = line[i];
    if (char === '"') {
      if (quoted && line[i + 1] === '"') {
        value += '"';
        i += 1;
      } else {
        quoted = !quoted;
      }
    } else if (char === ',' && !quoted) {
      fields.push(value);
      value = '';
    } else {
      value += char;
    }
  }

  if (quoted) throw new Error('Unclosed quoted field');
  fields.push(value);
  return fields;
}

function importPressureReadings(csv) {
  if (typeof csv !== 'string') throw new TypeError('CSV input must be a string');
  if (!csv.trim()) return [];

  const lines = csv.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  const header = parseCsvLine(lines.shift().replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')).map(value => value.trim());
  const required = ['circuit_id', 'recorded_at', 'start_psi', 'end_psi', 'minutes'];
  const indices = required.map(name => header.indexOf(name));
  if (indices.some(index => index < 0)) {
    throw new Error('CSV is missing a required column');
  }

  const readings = [];
  for (const [lineIndex, line] of lines.entries()) {
    if (!line.trim()) continue;
    const row = parseCsvLine(line);
    const values = indices.map(index => (row[index] || '').trim());
    if (values.some(value => value === '')) {
      throw new Error(`Row ${lineIndex + 2} has a missing value`);
    }

    const [circuitId, recordedAt, startText, endText, minutesText] = values;
    const startPsi = Number(startText);
    const endPsi = Number(endText);
    const minutes = Number(minutesText);
    if (![startPsi, endPsi, minutes].every(Number.isFinite) || minutes <= 0) {
      throw new Error(`Row ${lineIndex + 2} has invalid numeric values`);
    }

    readings.push({
      circuitId,
      recordedAt,
      startPsi,
      endPsi,
      minutes,
      pressureDecayPsiPerMinute: (startPsi - endPsi) / minutes
    });
  }

  return readings;
}

module.exports = { importPressureReadings };
EOF

'use strict';

function parseCsvLine(line) {
  const fields = [];
  let value = '';
  let quoted = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i += 1) {
    const char = line[i];
    if (char === '"') {
      if (quoted && line[i + 1] === '"') {
        value += '"';
        i += 1;
      } else {
        quoted = !quoted;
      }
    } else if (char === ',' && !quoted) {
      fields.push(value);
      value = '';
    } else {
      value += char;
    }
  }

  if (quoted) throw new Error('Unclosed quoted field');
  fields.push(value);
  return fields;
}

function importPressureReadings(csv) {
  if (typeof csv !== 'string') throw new TypeError('CSV input must be a string');
  if (!csv.trim()) return [];

  const lines = csv.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  const header = parseCsvLine(lines.shift().replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')).map(value => value.trim());
  const required = ['circuit_id', 'recorded_at', 'start_psi', 'end_psi', 'minutes'];
  const indices = required.map(name => header.indexOf(name));
  if (indices.some(index => index < 0)) {
    throw new Error('CSV is missing a required column');
  }

  const readings = [];
  for (const [lineIndex, line] of lines.entries()) {
    if (!line.trim()) continue;
    const row = parseCsvLine(line);
    const values = indices.map(index => (row[index] || '').trim());
    if (values.some(value => value === '')) {
      throw new Error(`Row ${lineIndex + 2} has a missing value`);
    }

    const [circuitId, recordedAt, startText, endText, minutesText] = values;
    const startPsi = Number(startText);
    const endPsi = Number(endText);
    const minutes = Number(minutesText);
    if (![startPsi, endPsi, minutes].every(Number.isFinite) || minutes <= 0) {
      throw new Error(`Row ${lineIndex + 2} has invalid numeric values`);
    }

    readings.push({
      circuitId,
      recordedAt,
      startPsi,
      endPsi,
      minutes,
      pressureDecayPsiPerMinute: (startPsi - endPsi) / minutes
    });
  }

  return readings;
}

use std::io::{self, Read};

fn quote(value: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::from("\"");
    for ch in value.chars() {
        match ch {
            '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
            '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
            '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
            '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
            '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
            ch if ch <= '\u{1f}' => out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", ch as u32)),
            ch => out.push(ch),
        }
    }
    out.push('"');
    out
}

    let words: Vec<&str> = input.split_whitespace().collect();
    let json_words = words.iter().map(|word| quote(word)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",");
    println!("{{\"words\":[{}],\"count\":{}}}", json_words, words.len());
}

graph = json.load(sys.stdin)
if not isinstance(graph, dict) or any(not isinstance(deps, list) for deps in graph.values()):
    raise SystemExit("input must map targets to dependency lists")
if any(dep not in graph for deps in graph.values() for dep in deps):

package electrical

import (
	"encoding/csv"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type Reading struct {
	CircuitID      string  `json:"circuit_id"`
	ResistanceMOhm float64 `json:"resistance_mohm"`
}

func ImportCSV(r io.Reader) ([]Reading, error) {
	rows, err := csv.NewReader(r).ReadAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(rows) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("CSV has no header")
	}
	columns := make(map[string]int, len(rows[0]))
	for i, name := range rows[0] {
		columns[name] = i
	}
	ci, hasCircuit := columns["circuit_id"]
	ri, hasResistance := columns["resistance_mohm"]
	if !hasCircuit || !hasResistance {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("CSV is missing required columns")
	}
	readings := make([]Reading, 0, len(rows)-1)
	for line, row := range rows[1:] {
		if ci >= len(row) || ri >= len(row) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d is incomplete", line+2)
		}
		value, err := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(row[ri]), 64)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: %w", line+2, err)
		}
		readings = append(readings, Reading{row[ci], math.Round(value*1000) / 1000})
	}
	sort.Slice(readings, func(i, j int) bool {
		return readings[i].CircuitID < readings[j].CircuitID
	})
	return readings, nil
}
